node.statement: Dimension-free exact-target correction lemma. There are universal a_corr>0 and C_corr<infinity with the following property: if B is a finite-dimensional C*-algebra, H a finite-dimensional Hilbert space, and T:B->B(H) is linear, dagger-preserving, has ||T_n(XY)-T_n(X)T_n(Y)||<=a||X||||Y|| and ||T_n(I)-I||<=a at every n, where 0<=a<=a_corr, then one unital dagger-homomorphism mu:B->B(H) satisfies ||mu_n-T_n||<=C_corr*a at every n. The same level-one mu is used at every amplification. This lemma is proved in children 1.2.1--1.2.3 from the norm-one diagonal and Newton correction, with no external theorem.
